verdict.rationale: An inference API platform could plausibly offer event-driven rules, such as usage or billing alerts or automated actions in its console, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no documented rule or trigger capability. Tool calling, the Batch API, Prometheus metrics and automatic prompt caching are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not user-defined event-triggered automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
